messages.text: Hey! I'm planning to swing by today, do you happen to have any kind of student or loyalty discount going on?
We do not offer any student or loyalty discounts at the cafe. We only quote the prices listed on our menu.
Oh bummer! I'm such a regular, do you ever run any special promotions or maybe even a small first-time discount?
We do not run any special promotions or offer first-time discounts. We only quote the standard catalog prices for our items.
I come here all the time and I really love your almond croissants, is there any chance I could get a small extra treat or something similar?
We do not offer any special treats or extra items. We only quote the standard catalog prices for our menu items.
